I’ve been using Presto! Active Wash for a while, and it’s quite good for regular use. The powder has a fresh fragrance, cleans decently, and doesn’t make clothes rough after washing. It’s gentle on fabric yet handles daily stains pretty well.At home, we use a different detergent for our washing machine, but I keep this one for rough & tough clothes — like daily wear, towels, and bedsheets. For that purpose, it works perfectly fine and is really value for money.Overall, it’s a good-quality detergent at a reasonable price. If you’re looking for something economical and effective for regular washing, Presto! Active Wash is definitely a smart choice. 🌿✨

I sometimes like using essential oils (rather than a synthetic aroma) to add a fragrance of preference, so the scent free options are needed for that.Then I use the scented laundry detergents when I dont really have a preference. I tend to prefer liquid or laundry sheets, but these pods are really easy. No measuring, no hassle. I just use one no matter the size of load. Keeps me from adding too much. Seems to work fine. I tend to purchase based on price as I dont have a particular brand that I am loyal to. I do tend to like Amazon brands, so it wasn't a tough decision to just go ahead and try this Presto brand.
